thread:
Sara: FYI customer acme-corp reporting intermittent 502/504s hitting hostedapi frontdoor eu-west-1 since ~11:20Z after a billing cache TTL eviction. Spike lines up with a burst of billing writes. Saw trace tr-9b7c.
Vikram: eu-west-1 — can you paste the trace ids + a sample request so we can correlate with envoy/nginx logs?
Sara: yes eu-west-1. sample curl: ```curl -v 'https://hostedapi.redwood.ai/v1/generate' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' -d '{"prompt":"..."}'``` trace: tr-9b7c. logs snippet: ```[envoy] http2: stream reset: REFUSED_STREAM; upstream: reset: connection reset by peer; downstream_rq_5xx spike```
Tony: this smells like HTTP/2 multiplexer exhaustion (max concurrent streams / conn window) at frontdoor or midproxy combined with long-lived streaming requests. Billing backend reported GC/latency earlier which would exacerbate head-of-line blocking. Hypothesis: long streaming sessions + billing write fanout -> h2 stream limits hit -> REFUSED_STREAM / resets -> 502/504.
oncall-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-2034 created and routed to eng-sre.
Vikram: can we repro? suggested steps: 1) start a bunch of long-lived streaming clients against eu-west-1 2) fire billing write bursts that fanout to auth/billing 3) watch h2 stream counts and downstream stats. Also grab envoy stats: `curl http://localhost:9901/stats?filter=downstream` on the frontdoor pod.
Sara: running repro on a test cluster now. envoy stats snapshot pasted: ```downstream_rq_2xx: 1200
downstream_rq_5xx: 84
http2.downstream_streams_open: 512
downstream_cx_active: 64``` — looks like streams open >> healthy limit.
Tony: mitigation plan (short): 1) lower frontdoor h2 max-concurrent-streams to 100, 2) enable ingress queue cap to shed excess, 3) bump midproxy h2 window size to 128k, 4) rolling restart two midfront pods to pick up config. I'll apply the small config patch and roll in 5m.
Sara: rolling restart started on eu-west-1 midfront pool. Pinging CS to update customer.
Maria-cs: Sending quick update to customer: "We've applied a temporary configuration to reduce errors and are monitoring. We'll follow up with root cause and timeline for a permanent fix."
Tony: after the rolling restart errors dropped to ~0.5% from ~8% over the last 10 minutes. Continue to monitor for 30m. Long-term actions: increase billing/auth throughput, tune client streaming limits, and implement smarter fallback (route to dedicated capacity when frontdoor stream pressure high).
Sara: :thumbsup: Opening PR for the config changes (frontdoor h2 cap + queue cap) and scheduling a postmortem with infra and billing teams. Will attach traces and the repro script to the postmortem.
